model: per fuel class: droplet = logistic regression, gas = logistic regression, solid = gradient-boosted trees

metrics.cv: leave-one-test-day-out, one model per fuel class, held-out predictions pooled

droplet.target: ignited droplet burned to completion (1) vs flame went out first (0)
droplet.score_note: p_sustain is a class-balanced model score averaged over the other settings of the context runs (partial dependence); it is not a measured frequency and not a safety score.

gas.status: experiment: does not beat the single-oxygen-threshold baseline on held-out days
gas.target: normal spherical gas flame still burning when the flow was stopped (1) vs self-extinguished, flash or no hot ignition (0)
gas.context: all training runs of this class
gas.score_note: p_sustain is a class-balanced model score averaged over the other settings of the context runs (partial dependence); it is not a measured frequency and not a safety score.

solid.target: solid sample burned on its own (1) vs brief flame only or no ignition (0); labels SI-extracted, human spot-check 20/20 agreed
solid.context: all training runs of this class
solid.score_note: p_sustain is a class-balanced model score averaged over the other settings of the context runs (partial dependence); it is not a measured frequency and not a safety score.
solid.pressure_note: solid runs all share the assumed 101.3 kPa glovebox pressure, so the model has no pressure information; support is near zero away from 101.3 kPa.

provenance: Trained by EMBER Track B during NASA Space Apps 2026 on data/clean/runs.json (NASA PSI). Code written with SI assistance; see AI-USE.md.
